presentation.scribes_view: deterministic in-universe chronicle using synthesized combat episodes; granular evidence remains in the journal/diagnostics
presentation.empire_timeline: selective chronology rendered from the shared Historical Event Layer, including major combat episodes and technology milestones
presentation.scribes_pdf: direct book-style PDF generated from the same supported chronicle text

historical_event_layer.purpose: normalized source/confidence/date-kind events with structured attributes; Timeline and Scribes consume the same synthesized presentation source. v0.0.47 adds conservative Politics/Diplomacy events.

character_evidence.rules: Leader death is promoted only from explicit retained death evidence. v0.0.45 accepts a retained LEADER_DEATH / MESSAGE_LEADER_LOST_DESC notification when its LEADER variable uniquely matches one known player leader, that leader has an unresolved exit in the same archive interval, and the notification date falls inside that interval. Tombstones and disappearances remain unconfirmed without qualifying evidence.

event_character_probe.raw_window: previous/current/next archived save around each leader exit
event_character_probe.rule: Correlation never establishes death or exit cause by itself.

notification_event_decoder.raw_window: previous/current/next archived save around each leader exit
notification_event_decoder.rule: Explicit typed leader references remain direct identity evidence. For retained LEADER_DEATH messages, v0.0.45 also recognizes a LEADER variable that uniquely matches one known player leader; death promotion still requires the matching unresolved exit and date-window checks. Missing notification payloads are never reconstructed.

requirements: LEADER variable uniquely matches one known player leader
leader has unresolved exit in same first-absent snapshot
notification date is after last confirmed presence and no later than first absent archive state
notification_derived_deaths.rule: Name/timing promotion is narrowly scoped to retained LEADER_DEATH objects; ordinary notification timing never proves death.

evidence: player-country candidate political keys and direct scalar/block values
relation scalar/block transitions between selected samples
politics_diplomacy_probe.rule: Raw keys and values are preserved literally. v0.0.46 does not infer or publish treaties, elections, factions, alliances, rivalries, succession causes or diplomatic outcomes from unfamiliar raw fields.

live_history.behaviour: when enabled, process newly archived saves through the normal incremental history pipeline and refresh Historical_Journal.html
live_history.safety: Review Campaign and Construct Campaign require Live History to be off

published_evidence: first archived appearance of player relation records
retained_not_normally_published: ruler identity mirror of People-domain evidence
politics_diplomacy_history.rule: No treaty, election, faction, alliance, rivalry, succession cause or diplomatic motive is inferred from unfamiliar raw fields.

incremental_history.rule: A Politics/Diplomacy parser or persistence warning must not cause an already-written core snapshot to replay on the next Update History run.

politics_diplomacy_v2.summary_localisation: installed Stellaris/mod localisation with readable fallback

live_history_route_hotfix.cause: v0.0.48 refresh migration matched the Update History journal anchor instead of Review Campaign

evidence: targeted raw first_contact/contact/communications keys and contexts
first_contact_probe.rule: Correlation is diagnostic-only; exact First Contact completion, counterpart and response choice are not published without direct retained evidence.

first_contact_history.counterpart_identity: contact.country resolved through retained country record and cross-checked with saved_event_target name=contact_country when present
first_contact_history.completion_rule: Unchanged: player or reciprocal counterpart completion marker must appear across the assignment-end interval unless a direct exact field is decoded.
first_contact_history.response_choice_rule: Diagnostic-only until a direct retained response selection field is proven.
first_contact_history.name_resolution: Render nested %ADJ%/%ADJECTIVE% grammar with installed adj_NN* adjective suffix rules; reject technical identifiers; retain candidate audit data.
first_contact_history.high_dynamic_country_ids: Allowed in First Contact only when the contact record directly identifies the country and its resolved name passes pseudo-actor filtering; generic Politics filter is unchanged.
